messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from yesterday's postmortem — recurring GPU queue throttling is correlating with P95 latency SLO spikes during nightly retrain windows. Need concrete owners + short/medium-term timelines.

maria: I can own short-term mitigations: cache priming + lower default batch sizes for retrain traffic. ETA EOW (2026-03-27).

kevin: I'll add a queue-depth panel and pool-level alert in the dashboard. Will link when done.

sre_lead: Heads-up: don't change customer SLA now. We should update internal SLO thresholds and the error-budget burn dashboard first so we can measure impact of mitigations. Proposal: review and decide by 2026-03-31.

beth: Long-term owner for capacity rebalancing and preemptible scheduling. I'll draft an RFC for pool sharding + autoscaler tuning. ETA 2026-04-15.

incident-bot: Postmortem created: PM-2026-03-gpu-queue-throttle (link in thread).

alex: Action items (summary):
  1) Queue-depth panel + alert (owner: kevin) — add pool breakdown + 1m/5m windows. Due: 2026-03-25.
  2) Cache priming + reduce batch size for retrain traffic (owner: maria) — test in staging. Due: 2026-03-27.
  3) RFC for capacity rebalance & preemptible scheduling (owner: beth) — due: 2026-04-15.
  4) SLO/error-budget dashboard update and runbook edits (owner: sre_lead & ops_reporting) — review by 2026-03-31.
  5) Smoke test plan and post-deploy verification (owner: alex) — rolling checks after each change.

kevin: Quick grafana/promql snippet I'll use:```promql
sum(queue_depth) by (gpu_pool)
``` Alert: gpu_pool depth > 100 for > 1m. I'll add a low-severity page and a slack alert to #eng-oncall. ETA: tomorrow morning.

maria: Testing plan for batch-size tweak: A/B retrain jobs 4->2 for 48h on staging, measure p95/throughput and KV-cache hit rate. If good, roll to canary and then prod.

sre_lead: For the SLO dashboard: add a 'burn' panel showing 7d cumulative error budget and a regression detector for P95 delta > 15% week-over-week. ops_reporting to own alert thresholds.

ops_reporting: I'll add the panels and a synthetic hourly check against /v1/generate to track P95 latency per pool. Will post dashboard link when complete.

beth: RFC checklist I'll include: current pool sizes, historical queue depth heatmap, autoscaler params, cost delta for extra reserved GPUs, rollback plan. Draft by 2026-04-08, final by 2026-04-15.

alex: Thanks all. I'll update the postmortem with these owners and timelines. Re-check in: Friday 11:00 AM PT in #eng-oncall. Please add any blockers before then. :calendar:

kevin: :thumbsup:

maria: noted, starting tests today.

sre_lead: Adding a short runbook item: when queue_depth alert fires, reduce retrain concurrency to 50% and notify platform oncall. I'll push that change to the runbook repo.

alex: Confirmed. Closing loop here, will attach dashboard links and RFC drafts to the PM on the postmortem doc.
